Every definition below belongs to `opmodel.dev/core@v2`, the CUE module every OPM artifact is typed against. An entry's summary, notes and field comments come from the definition's doc comment; its spec, the definitions it uses and the rules CUE enforces are read off the CUE source.

## Pages

- [Modules and instances](/docs/reference/definitions/modules-and-instances/): The module an author publishes, the instance that deploys it, and the identity the instance hands its components.
- [Components](/docs/reference/definitions/components/): The component a module is built from, and the names it computes for itself.
- [Resources, traits and blueprints](/docs/reference/definitions/resources-traits-and-blueprints/): The three primitives a catalog defines and a component attaches.
- [Transformers](/docs/reference/definitions/transformers/): The transformer that turns a matched component into platform objects, and the context it renders with.
- [Catalogs and platforms](/docs/reference/definitions/catalogs-and-platforms/): The catalog that publishes contracts and transformers, and the platform that admits catalogs.
- [Publish gates](/docs/reference/definitions/publish-gates/): The definitions a publishing tool unifies an artifact against before it publishes.
- [Secrets and configuration](/docs/reference/definitions/secrets-and-config/): The secret type module authors put on sensitive values, and the Secret and ConfigMap schemas catalogs build on.
- [Names, paths and versions](/docs/reference/definitions/names-paths-and-versions/): The constraint types for names, module and package paths, versions, keys and labels.

| Definition | Page | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`#Module`](/docs/reference/definitions/modules-and-instances/#module) | Modules and instances | The portable application blueprint created by developers and/or platform teams. |

| [`#SecretSchema`](/docs/reference/definitions/secrets-and-config/#secretschema) | Secrets and configuration | Secret specification for K8s Secret resources. |
